mapper.select: select p.person_id as personId, p.name as personName, coalesce(d.dept_name, '') as personDept from jc_person p left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = p.dept_id and d.del_flag = '0' where p.person_id = #{personId} and p.del_flag = '0'

select p.person_id as personId, p.person_code as personCode, p.name as personName, coalesce(d.dept_name, '') as personDept from jc_person p left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = p.dept_id and d.del_flag = '0' where p.del_flag = '0'
and (p.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.person_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by p.person_id limit 20
select count(1) from jc_conduct_issue where person_id = #{personId} and del_flag = '0' and status in ('0','1')
select issue_id from jc_rectify_issue where source_type = 'conduct' and source_ref = #{sourceRef} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select max(issue_no) from jc_rectify_issue where issue_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
